protocol: Each retained launch starts a new interpreter and performs exactly one first public NearestNeighbors fit/query. There are no warmups, metadata preflight requests, harness-driven native preimports or external pre-fit MLX synchronization. NumPy import and fixture X/Q loading are reported separately from estimator import/setup and API calls. Necessary transitive library imports remain charged. The first stdout result marker follows returned NumPy neighbors, before audits and runtime metadata. Parent process-start-to-result includes interpreter startup, fixture input loading, estimator imports, fit/query and result-marker IPC. Process elapsed also includes post-result audits/metadata/exit. This is process-cold, not a claim of cold OS/filesystem/Metal disk caches. All launches are serial.
accuracy_reference: Unchanged broad fixture oracles and strict canonical audit_search; every launch is audited after timing. Accuracy failures never remove timings or speed denominators.

Otherwise rebuild from the source archive and included build files. Source-only portable fallback is supported but is not the measured native configuration.
